description: A quiet one-line note Baude adds to the chat about what happened around the conversation (resumed, interrupted, a turn's error, the model or folder changed, a denied call…): small, dimmed, left-aligned, selectable, in order with the messages.

parts.name: note
parts.shows: Plain text (not markdown) at 0.85em (font.small), 60% opacity, wrapping, selectable, full column width.

states.name: resumed
states.shows: "— Resumed —" where you first wrote to a past session you opened (not on opening it), above your message, only when its agent is started again for it (a host chat whose agent is still running, at a turn or between turns, is attached to with no mark); "— Resumed from network error —" / "— Resumed from claude binary error —" when the chat's claude had gone and was started again.

decisions.said: 'The connection's gone. Send a message to carry on' was not useful; a session killed for inactivity should be resumed like any resumed chat, with nothing started before the first message.
decisions.rule: Every app says nothing when a chat's agent has gone while idle; the next message starts it again (nothing is started before it) and the chat notes '— Resumed from <reason> —' above it, as for any resumed chat.

decisions.said: Chats kept showing a '— Resumed —' mark, after which nothing seemed to be happening (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app marks '— Resumed —' only where a chat's agent was started again on its conversation. Opening a chat mid-turn, or writing in one whose agent is still running on its host, attaches to that agent and puts no mark.

states.name: interrupted
states.shows: "Interrupted" once, after a turn you stopped (Esc / stop button), unless a tool card it cut short already says interrupted. Also from history for a stopped turn.

decisions.said: Pressing Esc said both an interrupt note and a turn-ended-with-error 'operation was aborted' note; the duplication is redundant
decisions.rule: Every app says one 'Interrupted' note for a turn you stopped; the error the stop itself causes (operation aborted) is not said again as a turn error.

decisions.said: Stopping mid tool call or mid reply ends with 'error_during_execution'; interrupting mid-turn is expected and should be handled normally (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app ends a turn you stopped with one 'Interrupted' note, never an error line (Claude's error_during_execution, an abort message, Codex's interrupted status)

states.name: stop didn't take
states.shows: "Claude hadn't stopped after 5s: ended it" or "Claude wasn't running: turn ended" ("Pi", "Apple's model", "Codex" in place of Claude for those).

decisions.said: A resumed chat's claude can ignore interrupts: each press only adds another 'interrupt requested' line (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: In every app a stopped turn ends: if the program hasn't ended it 5 s after the interrupt, it is stopped and the chat takes a message again, with one line saying so; if nothing was running, the turn ends at once; pressing stop again meanwhile adds nothing

states.name: turn error
states.shows: "Turn ended with error: <what claude said>" (unless the reply already showed that error as an API error line). For a chat whose folder is gone on another host: "Turn ended with error: <why>: start a new chat in <folder> on <host> to carry on".

states.name: settings changed
states.shows: "Model → <model>" (": a new conversation" when it had to start afresh), "Thinking effort → <level>", "Permission mode → <mode>", "Folder → <path>" (" (conversation continues)"), "Folder not changed: …", "Not a folder: <path>", "Claude is running in <path>".

states.name: other
states.shows: Host and process notes ("Starting <machine>'s host process…", "Failed to start Claude: …", "Couldn't reach <host>: …", "Signing out…", "Worktree <name> was removed: …"), attach/paste failures ("Can't attach <path>: not a file", "Paste failed: …"), "Stop requested for <task>", "Control error: …", "Stderr: <line>".

decisions.said: The same couldn't-reach note was repeated over and over in the chat
decisions.rule: Every app says each kind of failure to reach or open a chat once per chat, however often it's tried again; a chat its host has no session for is said as missing, not as a failure each try.

decisions.said: Codex's JSON log lines (an unknown-model warning, a telemetry 400) were shown raw in the chat and shouldn't surface
decisions.rule: Every app drops Codex's tracing log from the chat: warnings and below, and its housekeeping (analytics, telemetry) at any level, are not shown; only the few lines the user can act on are, in the app's own words.

states.name: claude events
states.shows: Claude Code's own events (its system messages) as notes in the app's own words, from claude_events.said by subtype and level: "Background agents stopped" (agents_killed); a notification's, an informational message's, a model fallback's, a slash command's output or a scheduled task's own text; "Claude couldn't save this chat: the disk is full". Any other subtype whose level is warning or error (a model consent or refusal fallback, a permission retry, an instruction size warning, missing attachments, a mirror error) shows its own message (content) when it has one. Every other event, known or not, shows nothing: never a raw event name.

decisions.said: Claude's system messages such as [system:vcs_state_changed] are shown raw in the chat; handle them better, maybe with links to the Git pane (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows Claude Code's events through the one shared mapping in schema/copy/claude_events.json (a note in the app's words, or nothing) and never shows a raw event or subtype name

states.name: repository changed
states.shows: Claude committed, pushed, merged or rebased (vcs_state_changed): "Committed on <branch>", "Pushed <branch>", "Merged a branch", "Rebased a branch", "The repository changed" (claude_events.repository), then a Show in Git link that opens the side panel's Git page on that branch (the chat's own branches when it names none), in the folder the event names (its cwd: a worktree or another repository) when that isn't the chat's own. The Git page reads the history again.

actions.does: Show in Git: the side panel's Git page, the branch the note names picked, in the folder the event happened in when it isn't the chat's

decisions.said: Repository changes claude makes should link to the Git pane rather than show as a raw event (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: In every app a commit, push, merge or rebase claude makes is one note with a Show in Git link to the Git page at that branch, and the Git page refreshes

removed.name: "a new session on <host>" (and "model → …: a new conversation on <host>") note in the chat being left
removed.why: The owner: a new session's 'new session in <host>' line in the current chat is absurd; it shouldn't go anywhere at all (paraphrased)

decisions.rule: Every note in every app starts with a capital letter and is in sentence case ("Interrupted", "Model → Opus", "Committed on main"); a word naming Claude is "Claude". The notes' wording is in schema/copy (chat_notes and the groups the states name), never a literal in an app.
